subject: Post-call recap + proposed technical workshop times — align security & procurement
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Murphy <alex.murphy@acmeanalytics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed technical workshop times — align security & procurement

Alex — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery:
- You run a mix of customer-facing and internal analytics models; data residency and SSO are primary non-functional requirements.
- Current pain: inference latency at peak and no standardized serving for open models.
- Goals: validate integration approach for SSO + private deployment and confirm perf targets for a pilot.

Next concrete step: technical workshop (45–60m) where we can demo a small end-to-end flow, validate SSO options, and map procurement/ops checkpoints. Proposing three slots next week (all ET):
- Wed, Sep 23 — 10:00–11:00
- Thu, Sep 24 — 14:00–15:00
- Fri, Sep 25 — 09:00–10:00

Can you confirm which works best and who from your security/procurement teams we should loop? If you prefer, we can send a single calendar poll. I attached a one-pager that covers what we plan to demo and the roles we recommend having in the room.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-platform-one-pager.pdf (PDF, 120KB)
From: Alex Murphy <alex.murphy@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed technical workshop times — align security & procurement

Irene — appreciate the clear recap. All three windows look doable; our preference is Wed, Sep 23 at 10am ET.

Please loop in:
- Priya Natarajan (Security) — priya@acmeanalytics.com
- Procurement inbox (for contracts/questions) — procure@acmeanalytics.com

Topics we want covered: SSO options (OIDC/SAML), data locality (EU/US separation plans), and initial quantization/latency expectations for the pilot. Also please note our security lead is time-constrained the week of Sep 20; if Wed the 23rd is tight for Priya, she asked to be given an optional "attend if possible" invite and we can bring another security engineer.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Murphy
Head of Platform Engineering | Acme Analytics

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Murphy <alex.murphy@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya@acmeanalytics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, procure@acmeanalytics.com
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Confirming Wed 9/23 @ 10am ET — technical workshop (tentative)

Alex / Priya / procurement team — thanks for confirming. I locked Wed, Sep 23 at 10:00am ET as tentative and sent a calendar invite with the provisional agenda:
1) 10m — Goals & scope (Irene)
2) 20m — Live demo: private deployment + SSO flow (Marissa)
3) 10m — Platform / ops considerations (Sean)
4) 15m — Security / procurement Q&A

Marissa and I will focus the demo on a privacy-forward flow (no production data) that shows token-level latency, prefix caching behavior, and how we wire SSO for a private deployment. Sean will cover runtime and autoscaling considerations for a pilot.

Attachment: redwood-platform-one-pager.pdf (PDF, 120KB) — included again for convenience.

If Priya can't make the live slot, please mark "optional" on the invite or propose a delegate. Procurement, if you have any doc templates or PO cadence expectations, please drop them on the calendar event or reply with a short note so we can include the right artifacts.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Irene
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-acme-technical-workshop
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Confirming Wed 9/23 @ 10am ET — technical workshop (tentative)

Thanks — I can take platform/ops and runtime coverage. I'll prep a short slide on autoscaling policies + dedicated vs hosted tradeoffs and bring our infra checklist (SSO, network, KMS). I'll also invite a security engineer (optional) to join the call in case Priya needs backup.

Irene — do you want me to own the shared invite details (stack access, required IAM roles) or do you want Marissa to add that section? Happy to own it to keep one source of truth.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Principal Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
